name: Ticketing
description: Ticket / issue tracking system with public submission, image attachments and admin notifications
author: Noah C. Omamalin

settings_fields.label: Admin SMS Number
settings_fields.description: Phone number that receives ticket SMS alerts when SMS notifications are enabled.

settings_fields.label: Admin Email
settings_fields.description: Email address that receives ticket notifications when email alerts are enabled.

settings_fields.label: Enable SMS Notifications
settings_fields.description: Send an SMS alert to the configured admin number when a new public ticket is submitted.

settings_fields.label: Enable Email Notifications
settings_fields.description: Send an email alert to the configured admin address when a new public ticket is submitted.

settings_fields.label: Enable Public Submission Form
settings_fields.description: Allow unauthenticated users to submit maintenance requests through the public form.

exposes.description: List ticket entities for entity-view consumers
Fetch a single ticket entity for entity-view consumers
